kind: passive original metadata-allocation settlement over already reserved successful list; no persisted schema
binds: full original plan/source/upload/immutable allowances via authority
exact pending mutation and observation IDs
original independent list request/raw baseline digest
current list request/raw inventory digest and exact opaque observation evidence
qualified original-allocation attribution/nonapplication/settled uncertainty and complete evidence
baseline: Retain before mutation; integrations qualify chronology, authentication, actual context/target and stable custody. Require unchanged full original baseline IDs/timestamps/sizes. Matching digests prove no chronology.

outcomes.Applied: Explicit exclusive original allocation attribution to a bounded new candidate ID distinct from source; never infer from zero/one/many candidates. Multiple candidates can support an explicitly attributed ID.
outcomes.NotApplied: Qualified exclusion of original allocation including transient allocation then deletion; absence alone is insufficient.
outcomes.Uncertain: Actually settled authenticated successful list cannot resolve original allocation; lost/absent/malformed replies remain pending.

effects: Pure admission only; no IO, calls, serialization, automatic receipt, refunds, retries, data write/load/start/terminal/reference or fence release.
spending: Existing journal alone owns receipt transitions and all consumption. Uncertain clears observation, retains unresolved mutation and original obligations/references.
qualification: Native passive claim/decoder and actual local accounting/reopen only; synthetic declarations are not IC effect evidence.
remaining: Actual authenticated allocation attribution, backend reconciliation/provider/transport, complete transfer and application/load/start/terminal/release qualification.
